title: Mother's apparition in the kitchen

tellings.quote: talked about it our mama was standing in that kitchen in a lightning storm

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at a US nuclear weapons site, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that a couple of days after his mother died, at home in Tampa, Florida, he and his family saw her standing in the kitchen during a lightning storm. He says the family talked about it among themselves afterwards. If true, it would suggest that the dead can somehow appear to the living.
